title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus
Department: Division of Substance Dependence, Department of Psychiatry
Eligibility: Completion of an ACGME-accredited psychiatry residency qualifying for the ABPN psychiatry board, and all USMLE Steps or COMLEX levels passed (Step 3/Level 3 before applying)
International applicants: Eligible: graduates of non-US/Canadian schools need a valid ECFMG certificate before appointment (or an unrestricted Colorado licence)
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4010721006, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Licence requirement: Active Colorado physician licence and DEA registration required before starting
Summary: One of the oldest accredited addiction psychiatry fellowships in the US, based in the University of Colorado's Division of Substance Dependence.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: University of Miami / Jackson Health System
Department: Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
Eligibility: Graduate of an ACGME-accredited general (adult) psychiatry residency and board-eligible with ABPN by the start; USMLE Steps 1, 2 and 3 passed before applying
International applicants: Eligible; non-US citizens/permanent residents train on the ECFMG-sponsored J-1 visa
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4011121029, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Application method: ERAS only; positions filled through the NRMP Match (per programme page)
Visa support: J-1 (ECFMG-sponsored) stated as the standard visa for non-citizen fellows
Summary: A 12-month addiction psychiatry fellowship meeting ABPN certification requirements, run by the Jackson Health System/University of Miami psychiatry department.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: University of Hawaii John A. Burns School of Medicine
Eligibility: Successful completion of 4 years of psychiatry residency; USMLE Steps 1-3 or COMLEX Levels 1-3 passed
International applicants: IMGs accepted with standard ECFMG certification; non-US citizens must hold a J-1 visa
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4011421033, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Application method: ERAS; participates in the NRMP Match; virtual interviews by invitation (Thalamus)
Visa support: J-1 only (non-US citizens must hold a J-1 visa)
Summary: A one-year ACGME-accredited addiction psychiatry fellowship (accredited since 1998) at the University of Hawaii with one position per year.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine (McGaw Medical Center)
Eligibility: Successful completion of a four-year psychiatry residency in the United States or Canada
International applicants: Not stated on official page (requires completion of US or Canadian psychiatry residency)
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4011621009, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: A 12-month ACGME-accredited addiction psychiatry fellowship at Northwestern whose graduates are eligible for the ABPN subspecialty examination.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Indiana University School of Medicine
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4011721030, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Funding: Some fellows supported through HRSA funding (per programme page)
Summary: Indiana University's addiction psychiatry fellowship offering broad clinical exposure, with HRSA-supported fellows.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: University of Kansas School of Medicine
Department: Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4011931053, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Application method: ERAS; programme also fills positions via the NRMP Medicine and Pediatric Specialties Fellowship Match (per programme page); interviews 17 August - 6 November
Summary: University of Kansas Medical Center fellowship training psychiatrists to specialise in the care of people with addiction disorders.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: University of Maryland Medical Center / Sheppard Pratt
Department: Division of Addiction Research and Treatment, Department of Psychiatry
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4012321002, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: Established in 1989, one of the first ACGME-accredited addiction psychiatry fellowships, training at the Baltimore VA Medical Center and University of Maryland Medical Center.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Mass General Brigham (Massachusetts General Hospital / McLean Hospital / Brigham and Women's Hospital)
Department: Department of Psychiatry, Harvard Medical School
Duration: 1 year full-time, or 2 years half-time clinical/half-time research
Eligibility: Completion of an ACGME-accredited psychiatry residency before the start date
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4012431037, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: A one-year ACGME-accredited addiction psychiatry fellowship across MGH, McLean and Brigham and Women's Hospital, with a two-year half-time research option.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Boston University Chobanian & Avedisian School of Medicine / Boston Medical Center
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4012421019, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: Addiction psychiatry fellowship with clinical training across Boston Medical Center, VA Boston and VA Bedford.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Wayne State University / Detroit Medical Center
Department: Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Neurosciences
Eligibility: Completion (or near completion) of an ACGME-accredited general psychiatry residency; eligible for Michigan medical licensure
International applicants: Eligible: ECFMG certificate required if applicable
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4012540001, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Licence requirement: Must be eligible for Michigan medical licensure
Summary: A one-year ACGME-accredited addiction psychiatry fellowship in urban Detroit covering substance use disorders across the lifespan, including adolescent care.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center / Geisel School of Medicine at Dartmouth
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4013221024, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: A full-time one-year PGY-5 addiction psychiatry fellowship based at Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center and the White River Junction VA Medical Center.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: University of New Mexico School of Medicine
Department: Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
Eligibility: Completion of an ACGME-accredited general adult psychiatry residency; eligible for a New Mexico licence, federal DEA registration and Medicaid/Medicare enrolment
International applicants: Non-US citizens must have a valid work permit or be eligible for a J-1 visa
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4013422052, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Application method: ERAS only; selected applicants contacted for interview
Visa support: J-1 eligible; H-1 visas not sponsored
Licence requirement: Must be eligible for a New Mexico licence and DEA registration
Summary: A one-year ACGME-accredited addiction psychiatry fellowship at UNM combining research, didactics and clinical experience with underserved rural and urban populations.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Research Fellowship (NIDA T32)
inst: Columbia University / New York State Psychiatric Institute
Department: Division on Substance Use Disorders, Department of Psychiatry
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4013521032, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: A two-year NIDA T32-funded postdoctoral programme for clinical/translational research careers in substance use disorders, in which eligible physicians can also complete ABPN addiction psychiatry certification requirements.

title: Clinical Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Weill Cornell Medicine / NewYork-Presbyterian
Eligibility: Satisfactory completion of an ACGME-accredited general psychiatry residency; USMLE Steps 1-3 (or equivalent)
International applicants: Accepted: additional documents listed for foreign medical graduates
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4013540049, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: A one-year ACGME-accredited clinical addiction psychiatry fellowship at Weill Cornell focused on clinical practice, scholarship and education in substance use disorders.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: University of Cincinnati College of Medicine
Department: Addiction Sciences Division, Department of Psychiatry & Behavioral Neuroscience
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4013821013, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Funding: Competitive salary and benefits, with opportunities for extra income
Summary: An ACGME-accredited addiction psychiatry fellowship with one opening each year, working alongside UC's addiction medicine fellowship.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Case Western Reserve University / University Hospitals Cleveland Medical Center
Eligibility: Board-eligible in psychiatry at entry; all USMLE exams including Step 3 passed before interview
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4013821039, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: A one-year ACGME-accredited addiction psychiatry fellowship at University Hospitals Cleveland accepting three board-eligible psychiatrists each year.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Oregon Health & Science University
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4014040001, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: A fully ACGME-accredited one-year addiction psychiatry fellowship at OHSU qualifying graduates for the ABPN addiction psychiatry examination.

title: Clinical Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Perelman School of Medicine at the University of Pennsylvania
Department: Center for Studies of Addiction, Department of Psychiatry
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4014121011, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: Penn's clinical addiction psychiatry fellowship based at the Center for Studies of Addiction, recruiting through ERAS.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Clinical Fellowship
inst: University of Pittsburgh / UPMC Western Psychiatric Hospital
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4014121058, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: A clinical fellowship combining didactics, diverse clinical experiences and mentorship to train psychiatrists in evaluating and treating patients with substance use disorders.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Medical University of South Carolina
Department: Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
Deadline: ERAS opens early July (2 July 2025 for the 2026-27 year)
Eligibility: Completion of an ACGME-accredited psychiatry residency before entry; USMLE Steps 1-3
International applicants: Accepted: international applicants submit a valid ECFMG certificate and proof of visa status
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4014521014, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Application method: ERAS; NRMP Match with the Medicine and Pediatric Specialties Match (per programme page)
Summary: Since 1996, MUSC's one-year ACGME-accredited addiction psychiatry fellowship has trained psychiatrists in addictive and co-occurring disorders in Charleston.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: UT Southwestern Medical Center
Eligibility: USMLE or COMLEX Steps/Levels 1-3 (Step 3 completion required); ACGME requirements for matriculation
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4014821028, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: UT Southwestern's addiction psychiatry fellowship trains five fellows a year toward ABPN certification in addiction psychiatry.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Baylor College of Medicine
Department: Menninger Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
Eligibility: USMLE Steps 1-3; eligible for a Texas licence on completion of residency
International applicants: Accepted: valid ECFMG certificate required for graduates of non-US medical schools
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4014831064, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Application method: ERAS; NRMP Medicine and Pediatric Specialties Match (per programme page)
Licence requirement: Must be eligible for a Texas licence
Summary: A one-year (PGY-5) addiction psychiatry fellowship at Baylor College of Medicine, ACGME-accredited since 2008.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: McGovern Medical School at UTHealth Houston
Department: Louis A. Faillace, MD, Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4014840001, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: A one-year ACGME-accredited addiction psychiatry fellowship in the Texas Medical Center training in diagnosis, treatment and prevention of substance use and co-occurring disorders.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: University of Utah School of Medicine
Department: Division of Adult Psychiatry, Department of Psychiatry
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4014931068, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: A one-year ACGME-accredited addiction psychiatry fellowship at the University of Utah offering four positions per year.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: University of Wisconsin School of Medicine and Public Health
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4015612057, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: A one-year clinical fellowship developing skills in treating substance use disorders and co-morbid mental illness at UW-Madison.

title: Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Medical College of Wisconsin
Department: Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Medicine
Deadline: Applications open with the ERAS fellowship cycle from 1 July; interviews early fall
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4015640067, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Application method: ERAS; participates in the NRMP Match (per programme page)
Summary: A one-year ACGME-accredited addiction psychiatry fellowship in Milwaukee offering two positions annually.

title: Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: University of South Alabama College of Medicine / AltaPointe Health
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4050140195, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: Child and adolescent psychiatry fellowship combining academic training at USA Health with community care at AltaPointe, including BayPointe Hospital.

title: Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Creighton University School of Medicine - Phoenix
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4050311179, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: A two-year ACGME-accredited child and adolescent psychiatry fellowship in the Phoenix area recruiting four fellows each year.

title: Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences (UAMS)
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4050421146, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Visa support: Sponsors both H-1B and J-1 visas
Summary: A two-year ACGME-approved child and adolescent psychiatry fellowship at UAMS accepting three fellows per year.

title: Child & Adolescent Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Kaiser Permanente Southern California (Fontana Medical Center)
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4050540193, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: An ACGME-accredited child and adolescent psychiatry fellowship based at Kaiser Permanente's Fontana Medical Center.

title: Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Charles R. Drew University of Medicine and Science
Eligibility: USMLE Steps 1-3 or COMLEX Levels I-III; at least one letter from a child and adolescent psychiatry (or closely related) faculty member
International applicants: Accepted: ECFMG certification required if applicable
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4050540002, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: An ACGME-accredited fellowship preparing leaders in culturally responsive child and adolescent psychiatry through clinical training and community engagement in South Los Angeles.

title: Child & Adolescent Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: Loma Linda University Health Education Consortium
Eligibility: Three years of ACGME-approved general psychiatry residency completed; passing USMLE or COMLEX Steps I-III
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4050540192, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Application method: ERAS (July cycle); NRMP Match (per programme page); interviews by invitation
Summary: A two-year ACGME-approved child and adolescent psychiatry fellowship at Loma Linda University Health offering two to four positions each year.

title: Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: UC Riverside School of Medicine
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4050540195, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Application method: ERAS only; participates in the NRMP (per programme page)
Summary: UC Riverside's two-year child and adolescent psychiatry fellowship offering a broad, balanced educational and clinical experience in Inland Southern California.

title: Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Fellowship
inst: University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus / Children's Hospital Colorado
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (ACGME programme ID 4050711021, per AAMC ERAS participating-programmes list)
Summary: A two-year ACGME-accredited fellowship of the CU Anschutz Division of Child Psychiatry and Children's Hospital Colorado.
